name: Macro Assist
description: Snaps your inputs to the timing of a loaded macro (configurable delay).

macro-path.name: Macro file
macro-path.description: Macro in .gdr (GDReplayFormat) or .txt format (see comment in src/main.cpp).

max-delay.name: Max delay (frames)
max-delay.description: How many frames (at the macro's TPS, e.g. 240) the mod may delay your input to match the macro.

frame-offset.name: Frame offset
frame-offset.description: Shifts macro frames by N. Use this if everything lands 1 frame early/late (0-based vs 1-based).

block-unmatched.name: Block unmatched inputs
block-unmatched.description: If on, presses/releases that don't match any macro event are swallowed. If off, they pass through unchanged.
